lines.text: Do you know how an app names a song in seconds, in a noisy cafe?
Your phone records a few seconds of sound. The music, the coffee machine, the chatter, all of it.
It turns that sound into a map. Time runs left to right, pitch goes up, and loudness glows.
Then it keeps only the brightest peaks, like stars in a night sky. Noise barely moves them.
Pairs of stars become tiny fingerprints, and it looks them up in a giant library of songs.
When hundreds of fingerprints line up in time, boom. That's your song.
Orbi Transfer matches too. A short code finds your file nearby, and only the right code unlocks it.
